//workspaces: apps/api and apps/worker are Python and have no package.json; npm skips them.
apps/mobile is DELIBERATELY NOT A WORKSPACE. It installs on its own (npm run
install:mobile) and depends on the shared packages through file:../../packages/*
specifiers, which .npmrc install-links=false resolves to SYMLINKS — so it still
consumes the same TypeScript source the desktop app does, with no copy, no drift.
WHY: apps/desktop needs React 19; React Native 0.76 needs React 18.3.1. With
mobile in the workspace array npm hoists React 19 to the root and is then forced
to nest the whole Expo tree under apps/mobile/node_modules to keep React 18 beside
it — but it STILL hoists babel-preset-expo and @expo/metro-config to the root,
where they can no longer resolve 'expo'. Metro dies with 'Cannot find module
expo/config' and nothing bundles, locally or on EAS. A separate install gives the
Expo toolchain one self-consistent tree. Revisit if desktop moves to React 18 or

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:mobile

//prettier: House style, matching the code that was already here: no semicolons,
double quotes, 120 columns. Both scripts pass --ignore-path twice:
naming .gitignore alone would drop prettier's default .prettierignore
lookup, which is what keeps docs/API.md and the lockfiles unformatted.
